::: {#exm-perplexity}

#### Perplexity of the two counting models

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
bigram_ppl = math.exp(bigram_nll)
uniform_ppl = math.exp(uniform_nll)
print(bigram_ppl, uniform_ppl)
```

On the validation text after its first character,
the uniform model has [perplexity](#def-perplexity) `r sprintf("%.1f", py$uniform_ppl)`,
the number of characters.
The [bigram model](#def-bigram-model) has perplexity `r sprintf("%.1f", py$bigram_ppl)`:
on average it is as unsure of the next character as a model choosing evenly among about `r round(py$bigram_ppl)` characters.

:::
